selection: Page hash order; exclude first page; inspect at most 8 pages per source, retain first 3 with >=60 OCR words and >=8 eligible disjoint spans. Four one-word and four two-word spans per page, ASCII letters 3..18 per word, original OCR confidence >=85, no crossing line or gutter, hash order. All shortages and exclusions recorded. Labels require visual review; never replace based on solver outcome.
labels: Clean: native text matched by coordinates to fresh OCR. Scan: original-image OCR proposals, manually reviewed against saved contact sheets; not ground truth before review.
split_policy: Source documents and all their pages/variants stay together; exact PDF and rendered page duplicates rejected; near-duplicate/related editions require manual grouping before freeze. Public pretrained-model exposure remains possible.
evaluation: Report by split, source kind, condition, candidate availability and source document. Macro-average documents; paired document bootstrap (10000 draws). Failures count as incorrect; missing executions make report incomplete. Variants are repeated measurements, not independent samples. No threshold/model tuning on test results.
scope: Known mask locations, raster inputs, ordinary visible words and same-line two-word spans. Native PDFs are sources of truth, not inputs to raster adapters. English government publication sample, not a representative sample of all redactions. Separate pixelation protocol uses mask-only approximate origin/baseline, no hidden text typography. Existing cases are development data.
